ns2:section.sectionText: Off-site section (meets at the Puerto Rican Cultural Center, 2700-2704 W. Haddon, Chicago); Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Meets from Noon-5 p.m. Saturdays, Sept. 6, Sept. 20, Oct. 4 (required on-campus session at Urbana-Champaign), Oct. 18, Nov. 1, Nov. 15, Dec. 6. Open to graduate students; juniors and seniors must get permission of instructor to enroll (abishop@uiuc.edu). Students can not enroll in more than one section of LIS 490CE/490CEL/490CEO.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to CAS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
